pattern: Friday high < Thursday high; target-session low < Friday low (strict comparisons)

universe.limitation: Fixed current Top 50 and Tech & AI membership; survivorship bias. Synthetic baskets have no executable OHLC and are not scored; their actual member stocks are scored once per page. SPY is context only.

tech_groups.name: Tech Software
tech_groups.note: Software ETF proxy; also includes selected interactive media/services. ETF weights are issuer-defined.

tech_groups.name: Tech Hardware
tech_groups.note: Devices, servers, networking and storage. Chip producers excluded from this selected basket.

tech_groups.name: AI / Semiconductors
tech_groups.note: Selected AI-related chip designers, memory and foundry companies. Their revenues are not exclusively AI.

tech_groups.name: AI / Non-semiconductors
tech_groups.note: Cloud, software, platforms, AI networking, power and cooling. Non-semiconductor primary businesses may also develop custom chips. ANET overlaps the hardware basket.

calendar: XNYS rule calendar v1, 2021–2027; 2025-01-09 extraordinary closure; literal Thursday and Friday required; Monday holiday substitutes Tuesday only, separate cohort; missing observations never imply holiday. Early closes included.
price_basis: Massive split-adjusted daily OHLC from completed operational sector, stock and tech collector snapshots; no dividend adjustment; no sources mixed within one symbol series
baseline: All eligible same-symbol Thursday/Friday/target triplets, without lower-high filter, same window and cohort. Also report nonqualifying control rate. Missing outcomes excluded from denominator and counted.
excursions: Descriptive target-open-based short MFE=max(0,(open-low)/open)*100 and MAE=max(0,(high-open)/open)*100 across entire target session; no entry execution or P&L claim. Target open below Friday low is gap-through hit.
market_condition: Friday SPY close versus EMA20 using at least 20 consecutive exchange sessions through Friday; never target-day information. Unknown when incomplete.
origins: prospective only when first recorded after Friday close and before target open; historical otherwise. Historical records never relabeled prospective.
limitations: Pattern hit rate is not trade profitability.
Pooled symbol-weeks are correlated; no independent-trial significance claim.
Five-year target remains required; shorter results explicitly preliminary.
Fixed calendar horizon fails closed after 2027.

presentation.tech_ai: IGV and actual stocks in the fixed Tech & AI baskets; deduplicate overlapping membership
presentation.top50: 51 share classes in existing Top 50 snapshot
presentation.live: PROSPECTIVE records only; independent lifetime summary and per-instance stats; current target-session month shown, older months collapsed
presentation.historical: HISTORICAL records only; independent overall summaries; no instance table
